Taking you to a random entry...

<p id="random-fallback">If nothing happens, <a href="index.html#all-entries">browse all entries</a>.</p>

```{=html}
<script>
// Pick a random entry from the index generated by Quarto (listings.json lists
// every page in the site's listings), so new entries are included automatically.
fetch("listings.json")
  .then(r => r.json())
  .then(listings => {
    const items = new Set();
    listings.forEach(l => (l.items || []).forEach(i => { if (i.includes("/concepts/")) items.add(i); }));
    const all = [...items];
    if (!all.length) return;
    const pick = all[Math.floor(Math.random() * all.length)];
    window.location.replace(pick.replace(/^\//, ""));
  })
  .catch(() => {});
</script>
```
